name: Beren's Peril
summary: In southern Silverpine Forest, Shadow Priest Allister moves against Scourge gathering in a hidden cave. The Forsaken hope to strike before the undead begin their offensive.

sections.title: A Preemptive Strike
sections.body: Shadow Priest Allister has heard that servants of the Lich King gather deep in southern Silverpine Forest. Their growing numbers threaten Forsaken operations across the region. So Allister sends scouts to strike first and destroy the Scourge in their secluded lair before they can mobilize.

sections.title: The Hidden Cave
sections.body: South of Ambermill, the Dalaran-aligned settlement, a hidden cave cuts into the hills. Its rough slopes make the cavern easy to miss, and the approach runs around the hills’ southern face. Ravenclaw drudgers and guardians dwell within. Destroying these Scourge remnants helps the Forsaken hold their ground in the forest.

faq.answer: Beren's Peril lies in the hills of southern Silverpine Forest, south of Ambermill. Ravenclaw undead dwell within.

faq.q: Who assigns the mission to Beren's Peril?
faq.answer: Shadow Priest Allister sends Horde adventurers from the Sepulcher after learning that hostile undead are preparing an offensive from the cave.

faq.q: Why are the Forsaken attacking the undead there?
faq.answer: The undead in Beren's Peril serve the Lich King as part of the Scourge. The Forsaken broke free of his control and fight to purge his lingering minions from their lands.

faq.q: How do you find the entrance to the cave?
aliases: how to get to berens peril
faq.answer: The cave lies in the hills south of Ambermill. Follow the southern face of the steep ridges to reach its entrance.
Scourge thralls dwell in the cave, including Ravenclaw Drudgers and Ravenclaw Guardians. They appear to be gathering for an assault on nearby settlements.

faq.q: What role does Dalaran play in this mission?
faq.answer: Dalaran has no direct role in the mission. Human wizards from Dalaran occupy nearby Ambermill, which Allister uses as a landmark to help scouts find the hidden cave.

angles.text: As a Forsaken, you help defend your people from the Lich King's lingering grasp by rooting out Scourge remnants at Beren's Peril.
As a member of the Horde, you help steady northern Lordaeron by clearing hidden Scourge pockets along Silverpine's borders.
As a priest, you follow Shadow Priest Allister's orders and help secure the Sepulcher's authority by destroying rival undead horrors.
